title: Poor Quality
text: Poor Quality. I bought this product because it was $1 cheaper than the MadeSmart product, which I had bought in the past and liked.  Unlike the MadeSmart product getting this thing to stay together as one tray was difficuly and the end result looks sloppy.

product_metadata.title: LIVORINI Expandable Kitchen Drawer Flatware Organizer | Large Plastic Silverware Tray Organizers | Adjustable Kitchen Organization for Cutlery & Utensils Holder, White Non-Slip Drawer Dividers
features: GET ORGANIZED – The Livorini expandable silverware & utensil organizer helps you get organized and stay organized! It’s the perfect size to fit comfortably in your drawers and keep your things properly contained.

MULTI-PURPOSE – These drawer organizers are versatile and can be used for so many different things. Sized perfectly to fit kitchen utensils, cutlery, kitchen gadgets, art supplies, office supplies and more.
MAXIMIZE SPACE – Expandable & Adjustable. Expands from 13" to 23.75" wide - fits comfortably in most kitchen drawers. Adjust to the width to fit your drawer for an instant custom fit.

FEATURES – The drawer organizers are compartmentalized into 8 separate compartments to keep spoons, forks, knives, kitchen gadgets, tools and utensils. It features a nonslip base to prevent the organizer from moving around the drawer and an inside non-slip lining to prevent the items inside from moving.
DIMENSIONS – Measures: 16" L x 13" – 23.75" W x 2" H. Expands up to 23.75" wide
